intermediates.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Mire Slinger battle animation sheet. Supplied image is identity/style reference: lean human woman, dark braids, olive headband with reeds, layered dark-green sleeveless tunic and ragged skirt, yellow reed cords at waist and calves, wrapped leather boots/bracers, leather stone pouch on hip, simple leather cord sling. Preserve her face, proportions and equipment. Exactly SIXTEEN full-body separate newly articulated poses in strict 4 columns by 4 rows, equal anatomical scale, generous empty gutters. All face RIGHT in consistent three-quarter tactical camera. Row 1 left to right: relaxed idle with sling lowered; breathing idle with shoulders shifting; walking contact near leg forward far leg back; passing step weight on near leg, far boot passing beside ankle. Row 2: opposite walk contact far leg forward near leg back; opposite passing step weight on far leg; sling windup with right arm raised and loaded sling extended behind shoulder; sling release right arm snapping forward toward RIGHT, free hand balancing. Row 3: close-range fist winding back while sling hangs; close-range forward punch with planted front leg and twisted torso; low defensive crouch with forearms protecting upper body; impact recoil behind raised forearm. Row 4: collapsing onto one knee; falling onto side with sling slipping down; final fully prone dead body eyes closed, sling resting beside hand; sling recovery with right arm lowering and body returning upright. Each pose genuinely changes joints and clothing, never a rotated standing cutout. No extra weapons, no projectile outside cells. Entire body/boots/sling inside each cell, no crossing gutters. Flat uniform green RGB(0,255,0) background including gaps. No floor, cast shadow, blood, effects, labels or grid. Original detailed painterly raster art.

outputs.prompt: Edit only TWO poses in this exact 4-by-4 original sprite sheet. Keep the other fourteen poses, identity, canvas size, scale, positions, painted style and uniform green background unchanged. Row 2 column 4 (far right of second row): correct the SLING RELEASE. Her right arm is extended toward the right; one cord end remains held in her right hand while the other cord end has been released, so the empty sling pouch and two leather cords trail as a loose OPEN Y-shaped whip curving forward/right. Do NOT draw a closed loop in her fist. No stone/projectile or motion lines. Row 4 column 4 (bottom right): replace the crouch with an upright relaxed recovery stance, both boots planted, right arm lowering the now loose sling beside her hip, free hand near chest; same body/head scale as row1 idle. Full sling and limbs within the cell and generous green gutters. Change nothing else.
outputs.alpha_prompt: Remove the green background from this sprite sheet. Preserve the sixteen characters and their equipment unchanged. Return them isolated on a transparent background.
